name: convergence-review-window-suite-split
title: Stop reviewer independent validates from poisoning done_prepare convergence
description: The done_prepare convergence invariant (deriveDonePreparePassConvergence in packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts) counts every executed validation_terminal event in the [last REVIEW entry, now] window grouped by (commandSetHash, materialHash, storyFilesHash) and hard-fails DONE when any group has more than one executed terminal. Reviewer lanes legitimately execute the suite during REVIEW because independent verification is the review policy, and the single-slot PASS receipt in test-evidence.json is evicted whenever a different validation identity persists its receipt, forcing the closeout validate to re-execute an already-executed identity. Observed on B-956f closing 2026-07-23: reviewer lane executed cmdSet 34090591 during REVIEW, a second lane with identity 15aa0ab1 evicted the receipt, then the TEST-phase closeout validate re-executed 34090591, producing unchangedSuiteExecutions=1 and permanently poisoning the window; the only recovery was a ceremony DEV to REVIEW bounce that contradicts the reviewer independent-verification mandate. Fix: mirror the existing reviewerReattestations versus postTestReviewerReattestations split inside the same derivation - the blocking counter must count only per-group duplicate executed terminals at or after the current TEST entry plus contradictory reused terminals reporting commandExecutions greater than zero, while pre-TEST review-window duplicate executions become observable non-blocking telemetry in a new field. This changes DONE gate behavior for the closeout convergence check.
